result.note: Tests the edition, venue states and troop strength of the India–US Yudh Abhyas exercise that began in September 2026.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–US Yudh Abhyas army exercise that began in September 2026:
items: It is the 22nd edition of the exercise.
It is being held in Uttarakhand and Rajasthan.
Each side has fielded 1,200 troops for the exercise.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because each side fielded 600 troops, not 1,200. The 22nd edition began on 16 September 2026 in Uttarakhand and Rajasthan, with drills on mountain warfare, drones and autonomous systems.
questions.source: India and the US began the 22nd Yudh Abhyas army exercise in Uttarakhand and Rajasthan, 600 troops a side, drilling mountain warfare, drones, and autonomous systems.
